item.title: Trump calls off Iran strikes, says deal is close
item.description: Trump stated that Iran and other Middle Eastern nations requested the U.S. to delay any attack, as a deal framework is emerging.

item.title: A first grader interviews his hero: a bird scientist
item.description: NPR connected a young aspiring scientist with a conservation expert to discuss his career.

item.title: How Cyclospora affects the gut and its transmission route
item.description: The parasite Cyclospora, which has infected thousands in the U.S. this summer, needs time inside the human digestive system to multiply.

item.title: Idaho fast food shooting kills three, city spokesman reports
item.description: Responding officers discovered the suspected gunman's body near the restaurant.
